one_liner: At MLB inning 9 the model's calibration error is far above the market's: model_ece 0.2034 vs market_ece 0.071 over n=2282 checkpoints.
three_things: The honest late-game limitation: model_ece 0.2034 is nearly triple market_ece 0.071 here.
Calibration degrades as the game ends -- a sharper contrast than the mid-game inning-5 window.
Sample thins out late (n=2282 vs 6021 at inning 5), but stays well above the n>=30 floor.
context_note: Descriptive expected-calibration-error on one in-game segment, not a prediction, not an edge or ROI claim. This is a segment where the market is better calibrated than the model; it is reported precisely because honest null and negative results are kept, not hidden. ECE on a single corpus is noisy.
